title: Tawa Pahit di Balik Gerobak
theme: Mengeksplorasi ironi dan humor gelap dalam interaksi manusia sehari-hari di pasar tradisional, menemukan hiburan aneh dalam keunikan pembeli dan penjual.

cover.prompt: Early morning at a bustling outdoor flea market, sun just rising, bathing the scene in a soft, golden light. Focus on an inviting, overflowing market stall, abundant with fascinating, varied objects: vintage vinyl records stacked, an eclectic mix of old figurines, and other timeworn discoveries. Earthy and muted color palette. The background features blurred, indistinct shapes of people, conveying a lively, gentle market atmosphere. Cinematic composition, shallow depth of field, rule of thirds, warm color grading.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: Pak Karta, a cynical antique vendor at a bustling flea market, observes and engages with a series of unique customers, from a suspicious individual and a shrewd negotiator to a superstitious man and a stressed student seeking magical aids. The day culminates in him comically exposing a con man attempting to sell a fake 'ancestral' keris, eliciting laughter from onlookers. Pak Karta concludes his day by reflecting on the absurdities of human interaction, finding an odd satisfaction in life's continuous dark comedy.
